lessons: Low pixel seam MAE is insufficient when overlapping candidates use different instance granularity for the same physical hand.

Accepted subwindows must not be relabeled as an accepted joined film without independent post-stitch tracking.
limitations: The preview is useful for visual comparison but is not a WORKING full-film artifact.
Frames beyond global 558 remain not started under this strict expansion campaign.
